rows.label: EMIRATE
rows.clue: The domain controlled by an emir

rows.label: BOROUGH
rows.clue: One of the administrative divisions of a large city

rows.label: PRINCIPALITY
rows.clue: Territory ruled by a prince

rows.label: DOCKYARD
rows.clue: An establishment on the waterfront where vessels are built or fitted out or repaired

rows.label: OILFIELD
rows.clue: A region rich in petroleum deposits (especially one with producing oil wells)

rows.label: NORTH SIDE
rows.clue: The side that is on the north

rows.label: OASIS
rows.clue: A fertile tract in a desert (where the water table approaches the surface)

rows.label: MIDFIELD
rows.clue: (sports) the middle part of a playing field (as in football or lacrosse)

rows.label: WELLSPRING
rows.clue: The source of water for a well

rows.label: FLIGHT PATH
rows.clue: The path of a rocket or projectile or aircraft through the air

rows.label: SCHOOLYARD
rows.clue: The yard associated with a school

rows.label: FIREBREAK
rows.clue: A narrow field that has been cleared to check the spread of a prairie fire or forest fire

rows.label: TOLL PLAZA
rows.clue: An area where tollbooths are located

rows.label: FOUL LINE
rows.clue: A line from which basketball players take penalty shots

rows.label: BORDER
rows.clue: A line that indicates a boundary

rows.label: MAGNETIC POLE
rows.clue: Either of two points where the lines of force of the Earth's magnetic field are vertical

rows.label: MINE FIELD
rows.clue: A tract of land containing explosive mines

rows.label: BOTTOM
rows.clue: The lower side of anything

rows.label: HIGH COUNTRY
rows.clue: An area lying above the piedmont but below the timberline

rows.label: UNKNOWN REGION
rows.clue: An unknown and unexplored region

rows.label: RIGHT STAGE
rows.clue: The part of the stage on the actor's right as the actor faces the audience

rows.label: MARKET TOWN
rows.clue: A (usually small) town where a public market is held at stated times

rows.label: RESIDENCE
rows.clue: Any address at which you dwell more than temporarily

rows.label: PROTECTORATE
rows.clue: A state or territory partly controlled by (but not a possession of) a stronger state but autonomous in internal affairs

rows.label: HEAVEN
rows.clue: Any place of complete bliss and delight and peace

rows.label: DISTRICT LINE
rows.clue: The boundary between two districts

rows.label: STREET ADDRESS
rows.clue: The address where a person or organization can be found

rows.label: PERIHELION
rows.clue: Periapsis in solar orbit

rows.label: HOME RANGE
rows.clue: The area in which an animal normally ranges

rows.label: CLOSE QUARTERS
rows.clue: A situation of being uncomfortably close to someone or something

rows.label: BOWELS
rows.clue: The center of the Earth

rows.label: TAXI RANK
rows.clue: A place where taxis park while awaiting customers

rows.label: POCKET BOROUGH
rows.clue: A sparsely populated borough in which all or most of the land is owned by a single family

rows.label: SWAP FILE
rows.clue: The disk space that is set aside for virtual memory

rows.label: BARREN
rows.clue: An uninhabited wilderness that is worthless for cultivation

rows.label: URBAN AREA
rows.clue: A geographical area constituting a city or town

rows.label: FRONT
rows.clue: The side that is forward or prominent

rows.label: END POINT
rows.clue: A place where something ends or is complete

rows.label: TRACT
rows.clue: An extended area of land

rows.label: THERE
rows.clue: A location other than here

rows.label: RAIN SHADOW
rows.clue: An area that has little precipitation because some barrier causes the winds to lose their moisture before reaching it

rows.label: RESERVATION
rows.clue: A district that is reserved for particular purpose

rows.label: COMMONWEALTH
rows.clue: The official name of some states in the United States (Massachusetts and Pennsylvania and Virginia and Kentucky) and associated territories (Puerto Rico)

rows.label: BACK COUNTRY
rows.clue: A remote and undeveloped area

rows.label: SERVICE LINE
rows.clue: The back line bounding each end of a tennis or handball court

rows.label: BEDSIDE
rows.clue: Space by the side of a bed (especially the bed of a sick or dying person)

rows.label: COUNTY LINE
rows.clue: The boundary between two counties

rows.label: PLAZA
rows.clue: A public square with room for pedestrians

rows.label: CAR PARK
rows.clue: A lot where cars are parked

rows.label: JUNKYARD
rows.clue: A field where junk is collected and stored for resale

rows.label: IONOSPHERE
rows.clue: The outer region of the Earth's atmosphere

rows.label: VILLAGE GREEN
rows.clue: A village park consisting of a plot of grassy land

rows.label: MEGALOPOLIS
rows.clue: A very large urban complex (usually involving several cities and towns)

rows.label: ARCHDIOCESE
rows.clue: The diocese of an archbishop

rows.label: COMMUNE
rows.clue: The smallest administrative district of several European countries

rows.label: SNOW LINE
rows.clue: The line on a mountain above which there is perpetual snow and ice

rows.label: LOADING AREA
rows.clue: A stop where carriers can be loaded and unloaded

rows.label: BEELINE
rows.clue: The most direct route

rows.label: PLANE SECTION
rows.clue: (geometry) the area created by a plane cutting through a solid

rows.label: SANDS
rows.clue: The region of the shore of a lake or sea or ocean

rows.label: HEMISPHERE
rows.clue: Half of the terrestrial globe

rows.label: LUNAR LATITUDE
rows.clue: An imaginary line around the moon parallel to its equator

rows.label: REACH
rows.clue: The limits within which something can be effective

rows.label: POLLS
rows.clue: The place where people vote

rows.label: LOAD LINE
rows.clue: Waterlines to show the level the water should reach when the ship is properly loaded

rows.label: THEME PARK
rows.clue: An amusement park that is organized around some theme (as the world of tomorrow)

rows.label: DESKTOP
rows.clue: The top of a desk

rows.label: GREAT CIRCLE
rows.clue: A circular line on the surface of a sphere formed by intersecting it with a plane passing through the center

rows.label: TRASH DUMP
rows.clue: A piece of land where waste materials are dumped

rows.label: POLAR CIRCLE
rows.clue: A line of latitude at the north or south poles

rows.label: VENUE
rows.clue: The scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)

rows.label: RABBIT WARREN
rows.clue: An overcrowded residential area
